name: Punjab & Sind Bank
title: Punjab & Sind Bank - 533295 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Record FY26 profit of Rs1,322 Cr (+30%) and business +14.94%, but NIM a low 2.55% and Q4 slippages rose to Rs355 Cr; management guides NIM 2.65–2.70% by year-end.

triggers.label: NIM 2.55% FY26, guided 2.65–2.70%
triggers.quote: we should be touching 2.65 % to 2.70% in terms of the NIM

triggers.label: Corporate pipeline Rs18,000 Cr vs Rs10–12k
triggers.quote: we are around Rs.18,000 crore on the corporate side

triggers.label: Q4 slippages Rs355 Cr vs Rs168 Cr
triggers.quote: it's increased to Rs.355 crores as against to Rs.168 crores in last quarter

triggers.label: ECL hit Rs600-800 Cr over five years
triggers.quote: What we are expecting anywhere between Rs.600 to Rs.800 crore

guidance.quote: For the current year we expect a deposit growth of 13% to 14%.
RAM we expect to cross 60% of the total advances .
PCR, we’ll maintain the last year's level of guidance 92 % to 93 %.
we would like to cross Rs.1000 Crore this year as well.
Credit cost and slippage ratio should be below 1 %.
we should be touching 2.65 % to 2.70% in terms of the NIM
We are planning to open 200 Branches.
We have taken a board approval to achieve Rs.4,00,000 crores by financial year FY 29.

prior_guidance_check.quote: In terms of our guidance, whatever we gave last year for FY 26, we could achieve most of them. However, we just fell short in our Net NPA and PCR.

red_flags.label: Q4 slippages up sharply, MSME stress
red_flags.quote: there was certain residual stress which we had told earlier in the Agri and MSME segments

red_flags.label: Net NPA and PCR missed FY26 guidance
red_flags.quote: we just fell short in our Net NPA and PCR

red_flags.label: Historically low NIM
red_flags.quote: The bank has a historic low NIM because of the low CASA

evasions.topic: Q4 slippage drivers and SMA trend
evasions.quote: So overall, my SMA book, which was over 9% of the total book at one point of time and now we are hovering around 4.21 %
That's an internal assessment that we’ll take at an appropriate time but I don't think that is required.
